$comment: Which contract ABIs are CONSUMED outside contracts/, and how (spec 075, FR-030/FR-031).
Committed on purpose: the set of ABIs we publish is a decision, not a directory listing.
`facets` lists artifacts merged into one ABI, in precedence order. WagerRegistry MUST merge
its two facets — the proxy delegatecalls unknown selectors to WagerRegistryIntents, so a
single-facet ABI silently omits every gasless entry point, event and error (measured: 35
members, incl. 9 errors the frontend could not decode).

contracts.name: TokenInstance
$comment: SYNTHETIC template ABI: there is no TokenInstance contract. The subgraph indexes tokens the
factory CLONES, generically, so this is the subset of events it handles. Declared as a subset
with a reference contract rather than hand-maintained, so the generator fails if any listed
event disappears from OpenERC20V2 or changes shape.
CAVEAT (pre-existing, unchanged here): `Transfer` is the ERC20 shape (non-indexed value).
The ERC721 templates index tokenId instead, so ERC-721 transfers decode with the wrong data
layout under this template. Out of scope for spec 075 — changing it changes what the subgraph
indexes; recorded so it is not mistaken for something this generator introduced.
